_notes: Death Knell's ground wave. Asked as 2x4 cells of 1024x512 on a 2048x2048 sheet, and the sheet is
that size -- but the drawings are NOT on that grid. SEVEN frames (the eighth cell, bottom right, is empty),
each row's ground line sitting 10-40px ABOVE a 512 boundary with its cracks hanging across it, and the
generator left faint seam lines baked into the alpha: a full-height vertical at x 1023-1024 and full-width
horizontals at y ~574-593, ~1103-1121, ~1557-1575 and ~2041-2047. A 512 grid would cut every frame's
cracks into the next cell and carry a seam line into four of them.
So: measured rects, one per drawing, 1022 wide (clear of the vertical seam) and 430 tall (the tallest
band that fits between two horizontal seams, y 1126-1555 for frames 5-6), each ending just above the
seam below its drawing. base_align puts every frame on one floor (the rows drift 20-40px against their
rects); content_crop trims to the shared content box so place: formation gets the wave's own wide aspect.
The sheet also carries a scatter of alpha 1-31 noise pixels (~390k, mean colour a dark grey-violet): left
alone, as it is invisible and removing it would be repainting.
